item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 10/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will continue to bring generally fine weather to southern China today. The monsoon is expected to moderate and will be replaced gradually by a warm maritime airstream in the latter part of this week. The weather will be humid, foggy and cloudier over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week. Showers will affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
